The main takeaway from our work is that
the second-order polarizable properties of donor—acceptors are highly sensitive to the substituent variation.
the second-order polarizable chromophores with high molecular hyperpolarizabilities are obtained by the use of electron donor and acceptor groups at both ends of the conjugated backbone.
